physics.integrator: Dormand-Prince 5(4) adaptive with PI step control, fixed RK4 fallback, 120 Hz outer cadence
physics.geodesy: WGS84 ellipsoid: meridian and prime-vertical radii of curvature, Somigliana normal gravity, Earth rate and transport rate
physics.atmosphere: US Standard Atmosphere 1976 to 86 km, Sutherland viscosity, logarithmic boundary-layer wind, Dryden continuous gusts (MIL-F-8785C)
physics.aerodynamics: Prandtl-Glauert into Ackeret with a transonic blend, Lock fourth-power drag rise, Wieselsberger ground effect, separation with hysteresis
physics.propulsion: spool dynamics with asymmetric time constants, ram drag, TSFC fuel accounting, mass and inertia change with fuel state
physics.ground: three-strut spring-damper contact with rolling, braking and lateral friction

anchors: WGS84 normal gravity matches published equator and pole values to 1e-6 m/s^2
sea-level ISA reproduces 288.15 K, 101325 Pa, 1.225 kg/m^3 exactly
adaptive integration beats fixed RK4 by more than two orders of magnitude on an exact solution
all conventional aircraft trim to residual below 1e-8 m/s^2 on the full force model
trimmed flight holds altitude within 0.5 m and body rates below 1e-5 rad/s over 120 simulated seconds

scope: Numerical integrity and model isolation. Not an aircraft performance certificate and not a physical claim.
